People are important in my everyday life - perhaps it would be helpful if I found a way to repay this favor. They all went out of their way to help me many times when I struggled. I want to give something back, for even a small thing like a simple word of thanks could make someone's entire day, and I'd be more than happy spent the hour talking. How can I be of help to you, and how can I thank you? I debated about which of the smaller pleasures of Sammy's presence or the privilege of his company, I decided to tell him how he made me feel as he handed out the chocolate and to have a funny life lesson, a reminder to not take life, expect life, too seriously, and to take in the simpler pleasures of life.
